newsitem.title: CANADA: Two Winnipeg traders fined for trading violation.
newsitem.headline: Two Winnipeg traders fined for trading violation.

text.p: Two members of the Winnipeg Commodity Exchange have been fined C$12,500 each for violating exchange rules on futures trading, the exchange said.

Donn McLaughlin and Domenic Bellasario, traders for United Grain Growers Ltd, were assessed the fines after an investigation by the WCE found they traded futures outside the WCE trading pits between October 16 and December 9, 1996.
"We don't condone bylaw infractions," UGG chief executive Brian Hayward told Reuters in response to the WCE action.
"As a company, we have not had many instances where we've had difficulties with the Exchange," he said.
